correctness.rationale: For arbitrary positive run lengths, classify factors by 0–3 transition patterns and use the iff criterion that a missing factor has both longest proper prefix and suffix present. Exhaustive run-type analysis yields ten disjoint types with exact inequalities. Their lengths give the polynomial; summing conditional types in the nine comparisons gives offsets 1,2,4. The actual verifier checks all 4096 quadruples with inputs in 1..8 and 120 larger inputs; 45328 MAWs match exactly. Computation corroborates rather than substitutes for the infinite proof.
